entities.summary: The Panha 2091 "Toufan" is an Iranian overhaul and upgrade of the Bell AH-1J International attack helicopter purchased before the 1979 Islamic Revolution. The overhaul and upgrade program is known as project number 2091 of the Iranian Helicopter Support and Renewal Company.
